title: 第25章 首席第26章 寻金鼠
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了

第25章首席
那人宽额挺鼻，脸上的笑容温和，可那双眼睛却带着威严，让人不由产生震慑感。
郁凡从此人身上隐隐能看到隐约的龙之气息。
看来真的是他-所想之人。
“郁先生，你好。”
先生主动伸出手来的动作让旁边的秘书一惊。
这人竟然让先生如此的看重，他究竟有什么特别之处？
郁凡倒也没有自持身份，毕竟这人可是一个值得尊敬之人。
“您好，先生。”郁凡挑唇一笑。
那人并不意外郁凡认识他，毕竟全国上下认识他的人可多的去了。
甚至在学生的书籍上-都可以看到他的照片。
“我对您可以治疗好子轩这件事较为好奇，所以想来亲自见见你。”
先生曾经在隔离室外见过陈子轩的情况，也了解陈子轩的具体情况。
身体的伤残不说，最难缠的莫过于那被隐藏在体内的病毒。
他眼色一深，那些人并未杀害陈子轩或许就是打着将病毒传播入华国的主意。
如今最初接触到陈子轩的人已经都处于隔离的状态。
而且根据检查，他们体内也带有那种病毒了，表面上看不出有多大的症状，但却在急速的破坏人的免疫系统。
再过一段时间可能生一点小病，就直接要了他们的命。
这些该死的家伙，是想灭国吗？
郁凡也猜测到先生见他的原因，他并未拐弯抹角。

只是淡淡道:“不过一点雕虫小技。”表明了他能治疗的态度。
先生笑着点点头，“既然如此，那就好。”
“可能还需要请您帮帮忙，最初接触到子轩的人都已经身染病毒，您可有解决之道。”
郁凡早就有猜测到陈子轩身体内含的病毒应该是波及到了一些人。
也做好了足够的准备。
他拿出手中的玻璃瓶，里面是他用自己储物空间的灵草制作出来的灵液，可以将人身体内的杂质去除，跟洗精伐髓差不多。
“您可以将瓶中的液体滴入他们所喝的水中服用，不出一刻钟便可以去除病毒。”
瓶中的灵液浓度极为纯净，直接服用担心他们的身体承受不住灵气入体，毕竟都是未曾修炼之人。
先生惊喜的看着郁凡手中的瓶子，“竟然有如此神奇的灵药？能快速的去除掉病毒？”
看到郁凡肯定的点点头，他不由的伸出手来。
还未碰触到瓶子，秘书已经先一步将瓶子接了过来。
郁凡并不在意秘书的谨慎，毕竟这人确实很重要。
和国宝没有区别了。
郁凡想到现在的郁家，钱已经有了，权势目前在海市这边也算是够用了。
可是在其他地区就不见得还有用了。
想了想，他决定还是要给自己多增加一些筹码。
他拿出手中的玉瓶，将它递给了秘书。
“这里面的丹药，可以解决您现在的身体状况。”
郁凡一眼就看得出眼前的人，虽然看似在中年的鼎盛时期，可身体的机能却在不断衰弱。
可能和工作强度大和长期的疲惫有关系。

虽然没有其他病症，可快速的衰弱也会致命。
先生沉吟了一下，并没有马上服用丹药，他不是不信任郁凡。
而是有些东西他不能只想到自己。

Chapter 25 Chief
The man had a broad forehead and straight nose, and a gentle smile on his face, but his eyes were majestic, making people feel intimidated.
Yu Fan could faintly see the faint breath of dragon from this person.
It seemed that he really was who he thought he was.
"Hello, Mr. Yu."
The secretary next to him was startled by the gentleman's initiative to reach out his hand.
This man actually made Sir value him so much. What is so special about him?
Yu Fan didn't hold his own identity, after all, he was a respectable person.
"Hello, sir." Yu Fan raised his lips and smiled.
That person was not surprised that Yu Fan knew him. After all, there were so many people across the country who knew him.
Even in students' books - his photo can be seen.
"I'm curious about the fact that you can treat Hao Zixuan, so I want to come and meet you in person."
My husband had seen Chen Zixuan’s condition outside the isolation room and also understood Chen Zixuan’s specific situation.
Not to mention the physical disability, the most difficult thing to deal with is the virus hidden in the body.
His eyes deepened. Those people did not kill Chen Zixuan, but they might have the intention of spreading the virus to China.
Now the people who first came into contact with Chen Zixuan are now in isolation.
And according to inspections, they also carry the virus in their bodies. On the surface, there are no symptoms, but it is rapidly destroying people's immune systems.
After a while, they may get a little sick, which will directly kill them.
Do these damn guys want to destroy the country?
Yu Fan also guessed the reason why his husband met him, and he didn't mince words.
He just said lightly: "It's just a little trick." It showed his attitude of being able to treat.
The husband smiled and nodded, "In that case, that's good."
"I may need your help. The first people who came into contact with Zixuan have all been infected with the virus. Do you have a solution?"
Yu Fan had already guessed that the virus contained in Chen Zixuan's body might have affected some people.
We are also well prepared.
He took out the glass bottle in his hand, which contained spiritual liquid he made from the spiritual herbs in his storage space. It could remove impurities from the human body, similar to washing the essence and marrow.
"You can drop the liquid in the bottle into the water they drink and it will remove the virus in less than a quarter of an hour."
The concentration of the spiritual liquid in the bottle is extremely pure. If you take it directly, you are worried that their bodies will not be able to withstand the spiritual energy entering their bodies. After all, they are all people who have never practiced.
The gentleman looked at the bottle in Yu Fan's hand in surprise, "There is such a magical elixir? Can it quickly remove viruses?"
Seeing Yu Fan nodding affirmatively, he couldn't help but reach out his hand.
Before he even touched the bottle, the secretary had already taken the bottle.
Yu Fan didn't care about the secretary's caution, after all, this person was indeed very important.
There is no difference between it and a national treasure.
Yu Fan thought that the Yu family already had money and power in Haishi, which was enough for now.
But it may not be useful in other areas.
After thinking about it, he decided to give himself more chips.
He took out the jade bottle in his hand and handed it to the secretary.
"The elixir here can solve your current physical condition."
Yu Fan could tell at a glance that the person in front of him seemed to be in the prime of middle age, but his body functions were constantly declining.
It may be related to high intensity of work and long-term fatigue.
Although there are no other symptoms, rapid debilitation can be fatal.
The gentleman pondered for a moment and did not take the elixir immediately. It was not that he did not trust Yu Fan.
But there are some things he can't just think about himself.
